verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents explicit bulk operations support, notably a dedicated guide on 'how to bulk launch workflows using our REST API' plus broader Records/Workflows APIs for retrieving, creating, and updating items and export jobs for large data pulls. However, evidence doesn't show bulk operations across other entity types (e.g., bulk record updates, bulk document retrieval) or rate-limit/throughput guidance for large-scale automation. missing for 10: documented bulk endpoints beyond workflow launch, rate limits/pagination guidance for bulk data operations, independent hands-on confirmation of bulk performance at scale.
